title: Java & Spring Boot Backend Developer Roadmap: From Zero to Job Ready
summary: This comprehensive course is designed for beginners aiming to land a backend development job using Java and Spring Boot. You'll start with core Java fundamentals, progress through object-oriented programming, data structures, and advanced Java concepts. The curriculum then dives into database essentials with SQL, followed by an in-depth exploration of Spring Boot for building RESTful APIs, handling data persistence with JPA/Hibernate, and implementing robust security. The course culminates in a significant e-commerce backend capstone project, allowing you to apply all learned skills in a real-world context, and concludes with dedicated interview preparation and resume building to help you achieve your job goal. With a balanced learning style, this program emphasizes long, detailed video tutorials and hands-on projects, fitting your preferred duration of 3-6 months.

modules.title: Java Fundamentals
modules.description: Master core Java syntax, data types, control flow, and basic methods, laying a strong foundation for all subsequent modules.
outcomes: Write basic Java programs using variables, operators, and expressions.
Implement control flow statements like if-else, switch, and loops.
Create and use basic methods and understand arrays.
Solve simple programming problems with fundamental Java constructs.

Utilize encapsulation for data hiding and modularity.
Design object-oriented solutions for common programming problems.
